mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post ( title, content, writer, view_count, created_at ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{content}, #{writer}, 0, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT post_no, title, content, writer, view_count, created_at, updated_at FROM post ORDER BY post_no DESC
SELECT post_no, title, content, writer, view_count, created_at, updated_at FROM post ORDER BY post_no DESC LIMIT #{page.index}, #{page.rowsPerPage}
SELECT post_no, title, content, writer, view_count, created_at, updated_at FROM post WHERE post_no = #{postNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE post_no = #{postNo}
